references.text: The same procedure for the bird offering is described here, where the priest shall wring off the head of the bird without tearing it completely off.
Continuation of the regulation concerning the bird offering, where the bird shall be torn apart at the wings.
The blood shall be sprinkled on the wall of the altar, the same practice as described in Leviticus 1:15.
The blood shall be sprinkled around on the altar, a similar blood ritual to that of the bird offering.
Describes how blood is to be applied to the altar, parallel to the blood sprinkling in the bird offering.
The priest shall take some of the blood and smear it on the horn of the burnt offering altar, a similar blood ritual.
The blood shall be smeared on the horn of the burnt offering altar, the same principle for applying blood.
